unplanned.title: Goods without a PO
unplanned.intro: Goods that came without a purchase order wait in the holding area for a buyer. Nothing of it is used until an order names it.

noPermission.title: You cannot take goods in
noPermission.body: Taking goods in needs the goods-in role on this tablet. Ask your team leader.

supplier.title: Who sent it?
supplier.hint: Type part of the name or the code, then Enter.

none.title: No supplier found
none.body: Type another part of the name, or ask the office to add the supplier.

material.title: Materials found
material.scan: Scan or type the material code
material.hint: The code on the label or the delivery note. Part of the name works too.

ask.title: What came?
ask.body: Scan the code or type it, then tap the material.

none.title: No material matches “{code}”
none.body: Try another code or part of the name. A material we do not keep yet is the office’s to add.

lines.title: What came
lines.goesTo: Put it in the holding area {place}: it waits there for a buyer.
lines.scanPlace: Scan the label of the holding area where you put it.
lines.full: One delivery takes at most 20 lines.

keys.enter: Put it in the holding area

ddt.title: Delivery note
ddt.hint: Its barcode, or type the number.
ddt.photoHint: The photo goes with the goods once they are in the holding area. Keep faces out of it.

place.title: Holding area
place.hint: The label on the bin or rack where the goods wait.

held.OFFLINE: No network: goods without a PO wait for it (the receipt takes its number from the office). What you typed stays here.
held.NO_PLACE: Scan the holding area’s label first.

action.post: Put it in the holding area

PLACE.title: That is no holding place
PLACE.body: Scan the label of a bin or rack of this site that takes goods (not a workshop’s, a customer’s or a transit place).

SUPPLIER.title: That supplier cannot be picked
SUPPLIER.body: Pick one of our active suppliers, or ask the office.

COLOUR.title: Pick the colour
COLOUR.body: A material that comes in colours needs the colour that came.

LINE.title: A line cannot be taken in
LINE.body: Check each material and its quantity, then send again.

done.buyerAsked: A buyer has a task: they name the purchase order or send the goods back.
done.buyerLater: The office asks a buyer: the goods wait meanwhile.
done.photoFailed: The delivery note photo did not go.

reception.title: Reception report {number}
reception.subtitle: Which work orders and orders these goods serve, what to reserve for them now.
reception.failed: The report could not be read
reception.noBuyer: The order names no buyer to tell.
reception.noteHint: Goes with the report and on the reservations.

fact.noPlan: No planning run yet: the open work orders that need the material

line.lotHeld: Lot {lot}: in quarantine, free once released

reception.tableLabel: Work orders and orders these goods serve

empty.title: Nothing waits for these goods
empty.body: No plan pegged this order line and no open work order needs the material: the goods go to stock.

held.NOT_NEEDED: It needs nothing more (reserved or issued).
held.NOTHING_LEFT: Nothing of these goods is free for it.
held.IN_QUARANTINE: The lots are in quarantine: reserve once released.
held.noReserve: Reserving needs the right to reserve stock at this site.
held.choose: Choose a work order or an order first.
held.noSend: Sending needs the right to write on the purchase order.

report.NOT_POSTED: The receipt is not posted: its goods are not in stock yet.
report.NO_ORDER: The receipt names no purchase order: there is no report.

reception.doneTold: The buyer was told on the purchase order.
reception.doneNotTold: The report is on the purchase order; its buyer could not be named there.

problem.refused: Some of it was reserved meanwhile: read the report again and choose once more.
problem.demand: A chosen work order or order no longer takes these goods: read the report again.
problem.nothing: Nothing of these goods is free for the chosen ones now: read the report again.
problem.forbidden: You may not see this receipt’s report.
problem.offline: No answer from the office server: try again.
problem.gone: This receipt is no longer there.

waiting.title: Goods without a PO: waiting in {place} since {since}
waiting.body: Nothing of it is in stock or used until a purchase order names it.
waiting.buyer: The buyer {name} has the task, due {due}.
waiting.buyerNobody: The buyer’s task waits for someone to take it.
waiting.noOrderYet: {supplier} has no open order to this site for these goods yet: make it and send it first.
waiting.name: Name the purchase order…
waiting.named: Posted with {order} into {place}: the goods are in stock.
waiting.sentBack: Sent back to the supplier: this receipt is cancelled.

held.noDecide: Deciding on goods without a PO needs the buyer’s or the warehouse’s right.
held.noOrder: {supplier} has no open order to this site: make it and send it first.
held.pickLine: Pick the order line for line {seq} ({code}).
held.hides: Give each hide’s area for line {seq} ({code}): leather posts hide by hide.
held.reason: Say why the goods go back.

back.title: Send {number} back
back.what_one: The goods of {supplier} ({count} line) go back: the receipt is cancelled.
back.what_other: The goods of {supplier} ({count} lines) go back: the receipt is cancelled.
back.kept: Nothing is deleted: the receipt keeps why.
back.reasonHint: The buyer and the supplier read it.

nameDialog.title: Name the purchase order of {number}
nameDialog.subtitle: The goods post into {place}, where they wait.
nameDialog.order: The supplier’s open orders to this site
nameDialog.lines: Each line to a line of the order
nameDialog.noFit: No line of this order is of this material and colour
nameDialog.hideAreasHint: One number per hide, separated by spaces or new lines.
nameDialog.reach: Posting puts the goods in stock in {place}, numbers their lots, moves the order on and closes the buyer’s task. A put-away task follows.

problem.tolerance: A line brings more than its order line allows: name another line, or send the goods back.
problem.hides: The hide areas cannot be read: one number per hide.
problem.line: A line cannot go to that order line: pick another.
problem.order: That order cannot take these goods (another supplier, another site, or not sent).
problem.period: The month is closed for stock moves: ask finance.
problem.changed: The goods changed meanwhile: they were named, sent back or changed by someone else. Read them again.

problem.write: It did not go: try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed it meanwhile: read it again.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this here.
problem.invalid: Something is not right: check what you typed.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.offline: No answer from the office server: try again.
